attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 original small card is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides mascot identity and anatomy only. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body with green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the real source hair, brows, and conditional facial hair exactly as observed: exposed short grey/brown temple hair, real brow hair, clean understated upper lip and chin, and a serious closed mouth. Maintain the brown/olive peaked military cap with gold central badge and dark brown band/black visor, and the brown/olive open-lapel military coat with pale khaki shirt collar and dark navy/black necktie. Keep the exact primary mild angle and roll, grey light/backing, and note-limited crop. Ensure a clearly rounded short U-shaped lower yellow head that immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline, with a very short broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure. Do not create a long pointed V-shaped jaw, separate yellow neck shaft, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open garment and fastening with coherent front/rear collar overlap and contact shadow. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories. Fine primary details that are indistinct must remain understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Actual BROWN/OLIVE peaked military cap with GOLD central badge and dark brown band/BLACK visor, exposed short GREY/BROWN temple hair and real brow HAIR, clean understated upper lip/chin and serious CLOSED mouth. BROWN/OLIVE OPEN-lapel military coat, PALE KHAKI shirt collar and DARK NAVY/BLACK necktie, only primary-exposed small GOLD collar/shoulder areas. Keep exact primary mild angle/roll, grey light/backing and note-limited crop. No spectacles, moustache/chin beard, closed high collar or hidden chest regalia; fine cap engraving indefinite.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed exact primary/matched analysis context, raw master, pair and white/cyan/alpha. Correct brown/olive peaked cap/gold central fitting/dark band/black visor, exposed grey temple hair/brows, clean serious closed face, open brown coat/pale khaki shirt/dark tie and primary crop. Reject pointed yellow lower face/throat V at narrow shirt neckline instead of compact rounded short chin and broad collar contact. Repair geometry only; keep actual cap/outfit/pose/light and note. Internal cloth/backing/frame/note opaque without visible cyan holes.
